The Peppered Coast is the name of the coastline comprised of the southeast border of the [[Kingdom of Breland]] and the eastern terminus of the [[Dragonback Mountains]]. This sea gets it’s name because it is peppered with islands, reefs, volcanoes, shipwrecks, and other obstacles, making it treacherous and unforgiving to navigate. Merchant ships carefully thread their way through the waters to and from [[Port Bogdeep]].

Occasionally, raiders or traders from the Wilds of the East are spotted along the Peppered Coast. Small camps of raiders, outlaws, brigands, or exiles are sometimes observed on the more habitable islands along the coastline. The occasional shipwreck brings out the scavengers in force; survivors often report being shocked and dismayed at how quickly and expertly the islanders could dismantle a wreck.
